channel.title: MIT Technology Review - Artificial Intelligence
channel.description: In-depth coverage of AI research, machine learning breakthroughs, and technological impact from MIT Technology Review.

item.title: Why Neuromorphic Computing Could Solve AI's Massive Energy Crisis
item.description: Brain-inspired hardware designs are proving dramatically more energy efficient than traditional GPU clusters for deep learning inference.

item.title: Researchers Discover Self-Correcting Mechanisms in Large Language Models
item.description: A new study reveals internal representations that enable transformer architectures to detect and rectify internal hallucination paths.

item.title: Quantum Neural Networks Demonstrate Quantum Advantage in Molecular Simulation
item.description: Hybrid quantum-classical neural networks have simulated complex biochemical reactions beyond the reach of classical supercomputers.
